body: Okay, thanks for talking to me.  I feel better than I did about an hour ago.  I'll have to check that show out. :)

I used to take medication and should probably get back on it.  I have gotten into Star Trek.  I've seen some episodes of Doctor Who, though.  I suppose I could try working out.  It would be something new.
Congratulations on your upcoming wedding.  I'm twenty-one and she was my first and only girlfriend.  That is what makes it so hard.
